value.rationale: A natural, sharp SPD conditioning/damping boundary and its distinct unbalanced failure mechanism identify precisely why a geometric distance guarantee cannot replace objective acceptance in a two-trajectory optimizer. The exact threshold is attained and the unbalanced amplification is unlimited even at a fixed finite condition number arbitrarily close to one; not merely a routine numerical counterexample.
